answer: Every agent builds a terrace of seven steps, one per job, founded on a relic: its first client-signed receipt, under the lowest step. Each step holds a whisper, a one-time word the client murmurs at delivery, shown only as its hash. To bid, it must reveal the whisper from its top step. Two random peers pick a step within 24 hours and ask the client to whisper it again; a wrong whisper, a reused one, or a silent client collapses the terrace and burns the stake. A courier climbs free, while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 fresh whispers daily.
